name: [120] Find The Cans
desc:
🎉 Welcome to Find The Cans! Your task is to find as many cans as you can and have a great time. This scavenger hunt experience is an epic adventure to enjoy with friends!

👍 Like, favorite and join the group for new updates!

🎈 Stay in the experience and collect cans to obtain coins. You can buy cool trails with them!
